**The Opportunity
** RS&H is seeking an experienced **Operations Leader** to lead the performance, project delivery, and continued growth of our **Southeast Aviation Infrastructure practice** . This is a hands-on leadership role for a technically strong aviation professional who takes pride in delivering complex airport projects with rigor, clarity, and accountability.
The Southeast aviation infrastructure team includes approximately 40 professionals, based in Mobile, Jacksonville, Tampa, Orlando, and Ft. Lauderdale, with additional support from planning, environmental, architecture, and other technical teams across the firm.
**Why Join RS&H?
** This is an opportunity to lead complex, highly visible airport work while shaping the continued growth of our Southeast aviation practice. As an employee-owned firm, RS&H offers the resources and reach of a national organization along with meaningful leadership responsibility, technical influence, and the ability to make a lasting impact.
**About The Role
** The Operations Leader will oversee operational and financial performance, serve as a Senior Project Manager or Project Officer on significant projects, develop a high-performing team, and strengthen relationships with airport clients throughout the Southeast.
**Responsibilities
** **Project Delivery and Technical Leadership
**

...

**Operational and Financial Leadership
**

...

* Partner with Division and Regional Leaders to advance annual business plans, market priorities, and sustainable growth initiatives.
* Balance immediate project and operational needs with the long-term health and growth of the practice.
* Ensure company policies, procedures, and quality requirements are consistently followed.
**Client and Market Leadership
**

...

* Communicate directly and proactively with clients to resolve issues and guide projects toward successful outcomes.
**People Leadership
**

...

* Support workforce planning, talent acquisition, succession planning, and career development.
* Foster an environment in which employees can grow while delivering exceptional work for clients.
**Qualifications
**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering from an ABET-accredited program or an equivalent professional degree.
* Current Professional Engineer license.
* At least 15 years of progressive technical experience within aviation, airfields, or a closely related discipline.
* At least 10 years of leadership and supervisory experience managing technical teams and project delivery.
* Demonstrated experience delivering aviation or airfield projects as a Project Manager or Project Officer.
* Proven ability to manage project scope, schedules, budgets, quality, and risk.
* Strong professional judgment and client-facing communication skills.
* Ability to lead independently while collaborating effectively across a national organization.
**Preferred Qualifications
**

...

...

**The Team

...

Service areas include airfields, buildings, facility planning, environmental planning, and environmental stewardship & resiliency. Join RS&H to define and master challenges, advance professionally, and build strong and lasting relationships.
**The Company
** Employee-owned, RS&H is one of the nation’s leading architecture, engineering, and consulting firms, with associates who work hard every day to create tomorrow together. We offer an exceptional journey from start to future.
